implementation.name: JTCPS3
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): closed -- jotego/jtcores has no cores/cps3 directory, so no HDL for this core is published; only the compiled binary is distributed, through jotego/jtbin (mister/jtcps3.rbf). jotego/jtcores/.beta.yaml lists it as a Patreon-early beta for mister, pocket. hdl_language_id and license_id are therefore omitted: with no published source there is no per-file grant to read and no language to record, and that absence is the closed-source signal (there is no open_source column in the delivered schema -- data-model.md §1.9). The core still counts as a core: its MRA files and its .rbf builds are published, so the hardware is covered. Machine mapping: 8 MRA files in jotego/jtbin's mra/ directory name <rbf>jtcps3</rbf>; 0 setnames resolved exactly to a MAME 0.288 machine and 8 through MAME's own cloneof relation to the parent that survives extract/machine.json's parents-only filter, giving 4 distinct machine_id rows. accuracy_id omitted: jotego's README claims faithfulness in prose but states no timing-fidelity level this build could check against data/lookup/accuracy_level.json.
